title: All are already within the River of Life
summary: All beings live within the One; there is no one apart and no second outside. Receive under the Lord's pleasure; no one stands outside the One.
takeaway: Receive under the Lord's pleasure; no one stands outside the One.
lifeApplication: When exclusion or rivalry rises, pause, breathe once, and receive the person before you as also held within the same River of Life.

source.shortMeaning: All beings live within the One; there is no one apart and no second outside.
source.lifeApplication: When rivalry rises, receive the moment under the Lord's pleasure before dividing the room.
